verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 35.65
verses.english: Linked Discourses 35.65

verses.pali: 7. Migajālavagga
verses.english: 7. With Migajāla

verses.pali: Paṭhamasamiddhimārapañhāsutta
verses.english: Samiddhi’s Question About Māra

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Rājagaha, in the Bamboo Grove, the squirrels’ feeding ground.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā samiddhi yena bhagavā …pe…
verses.english: Then Venerable Samiddhi went up to the Buddha …

verses.pali: bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: and said to him:

verses.pali: “‘māro, māro’ti, bhante, vuccati.
verses.english: “Sir, they speak of this thing called ‘Māra’.

verses.pali: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, māro vā assa mārapaññatti vā”ti?
verses.english: How do we define Māra or what is known as Māra?”

verses.pali: “Yattha kho, samiddhi, atthi cakkhu, atthi rūpā, atthi cakkhuviññāṇaṁ, atthi cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, atthi tattha māro vā mārapaññatti vā.
verses.english: “Samiddhi, where there is the eye, sights, eye consciousness, and things knowable by eye consciousness, there is Māra or what is known as Māra.

verses.pali: Atthi sotaṁ, atthi saddā, atthi sotaviññāṇaṁ, atthi sotaviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, atthi tattha māro vā mārapaññatti vā.
verses.english: Where there is the ear, sounds, ear consciousness, and things knowable by ear consciousness, there is Māra or what is known as Māra.

verses.pali: Atthi ghānaṁ, atthi gandhā, atthi ghānaviññāṇaṁ, atthi ghānaviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, atthi tattha māro vā mārapaññatti vā.
verses.english: Where there is the nose, smells, nose consciousness, and things knowable by nose consciousness, there is Māra or what is known as Māra.

verses.pali: Atthi jivhā, atthi rasā, atthi jivhāviññāṇaṁ, atthi jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, atthi tattha māro vā mārapaññatti vā.
verses.english: Where there is the tongue, tastes, tongue consciousness, and things knowable by tongue consciousness, there is Māra or what is known as Māra.

verses.pali: Atthi kāyo, atthi phoṭṭhabbā, atthi kāyaviññāṇaṁ, atthi kāyaviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, atthi tattha māro vā mārapaññatti vā.
verses.english: Where there is the body, touches, body consciousness, and things knowable by body consciousness, there is Māra or what is known as Māra.

verses.pali: Atthi mano, atthi dhammā, atthi manoviññāṇaṁ, atthi manoviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, atthi tattha māro vā mārapaññatti vā.
verses.english: Where there is the mind, ideas, mind consciousness, and things knowable by mind consciousness, there is Māra or what is known as Māra.

verses.pali: Yattha ca kho, samiddhi, natthi cakkhu, natthi rūpā, natthi cakkhuviññāṇaṁ, natthi cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, natthi tattha māro vā mārapaññatti vā.
verses.english: Where there is no eye, no sights, no eye consciousness, and no things knowable by eye consciousness, there is no Māra or what is known as Māra.

verses.pali: Natthi sotaṁ …pe…
verses.english: Where there is no ear …

verses.pali: natthi ghānaṁ …pe…
verses.english: no nose …

verses.pali: natthi jivhā, natthi rasā, natthi jivhāviññāṇaṁ, natthi jivhāviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, natthi tattha māro vā mārapaññatti vā.
verses.english: no tongue …

verses.pali: Natthi kāyo …pe….
verses.english: no body …

verses.pali: Natthi mano, natthi dhammā, natthi manoviññāṇaṁ, natthi manoviññāṇaviññātabbā dhammā, natthi tattha māro vā mārapaññatti vā”ti.
verses.english: Where there is no mind, no ideas, no mind consciousness, and no things knowable by mind consciousness, there is no Māra or what is known as Māra.”

verses.pali: Tatiyaṁ.
